name: Steins;???
summary: Steins;??? (tentative title) is an upcoming video game developed by Chiyomaru Studio and Mages, the latter of which would publish the game. It is a thematic sequel to Steins;Gate (2009), and is part of the Science Adventure series. The game is written by Mages' representative director Chiyomaru Shikura, and previously went under the working title Steins;God
